headline: Executive order creates a White House initiative focused on education and economic opportunity for Native Americans and support for Tribal Colleges and Universities.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a White House Initiative aimed at improving education and economic opportunity for Native Americans. It also focuses on strengthening Tribal Colleges and Universities. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies lead the effort, what programs or funding are involved, and any deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The initiative is aimed at improving their educational and economic opportunities.
The order is meant to strengthen these schools, though the specific support is not described in the title.
Their communities are the focus of the initiative's education and economic goals.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 11, 2021; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
